subject: 英語
title: 第二冊單元4 第3～4課
unit: 數量詞與 How many/How much

bank.s: My brother put lots of ___ in his tea. It tasted good at first, but soon he felt tired easily. Now, he tries to drink it with less.
bank.e: sugar 糖（不可數）。茶裡加太多糖，喝起來好喝但容易累。

bank.s: Last weekend, one of my ___ visited us from another city. He told us funny stories about my dad when he was young.
bank.e: relative 親戚。one of + 複數名詞。

bank.s: When John took a small bite of the ___ fruit, his eyes lit up with surprise. He quickly reached for another piece.
bank.e: sweet 甜的。水果很甜，所以他馬上再拿一塊。

bank.s: I am so ___. Can I have a glass of water?
bank.e: thirsty 口渴的。

bank.s: The store ___ helped me find the right size of the T-shirt.
bank.e: clerk 店員。

bank.s: The sun is so ___ today. You should put on your dark glasses.
bank.e: bright 明亮的；dark glasses 墨鏡。

bank.s: Could you ___ me your pen? I forgot mine at home.
bank.e: lend＋物品＋to＋人 或 lend＋人＋物品：借出給某人。borrow 是「借入」。

bank.s: Can I ___ your bike? I will give it back to you tomorrow.
bank.e: borrow＋物品＋from＋人：向某人借來。這裡是「我」要借入。

bank.s: John ___ 100 dollars from me last week, and he still hasn't given it back.
bank.e: borrowed … from me 向我借了。若用 lend 則是 I lent 100 dollars to John。

bank.s: Do you need anything ___? We have cookies and juice, too.
bank.e: else 置於不定代名詞 anything／anyone／something 之後做後位修飾：anything else 其他的東西。

bank.s: Where ___ can we go this Sunday? The park is closed.
bank.e: else 也可置於疑問詞後：where else／who else／what else。

bank.s: This chair is broken. Please bring me ___ one.
bank.e: another 另一的（可當代名詞「另一個」）。

bank.s: It is very ___ in the room. Let's turn on the light.
bank.e: dark 暗的。

bank.s: The test was very ___. Everyone finished it in ten minutes.
bank.e: easy 容易的。

bank.s: I'm busy now. Let's talk about it ___.
bank.e: later 晚點；之後；待會兒。

bank.s: Do you go to school ___ bus or on foot?
bank.e: by 藉由；搭乘：by bus 搭公車。

bank.s: I was very hungry, ___ I ate two hamburgers and a piece of pie.
bank.e: so 所以：前因後果。

bank.s: I like pizza, ___ my sister doesn't. She likes salad.
bank.e: but 但是：前後語意相反。

bank.s: We ___ soup with a spoon in Taiwan.
bank.e: 「喝」湯的動詞用 eat 或 have，不用 drink。

bank.s: I can't see the words clearly. I need a new pair of ___.
bank.e: a pair of glasses 一副眼鏡。glass 當「玻璃杯」可數，「玻璃」不可數。

bank.s:
Willy: Thank you for ___ me around town. I had a wonderful time.
Lucy: The pleasure is all mine.
bank.e: show＋人＋around 帶某人參觀、引導。show 也有「表演／上映」的意思。

bank.s: Don't be mad! I was just ___. I didn't mean it.
bank.e: kid 當動詞是「開玩笑」：I was just kidding.／No kidding.

bank.s: The ___ person to finish lunch will have to mop the floor, so I have to eat more quickly.
bank.e: last 最後的（形容詞）。last 當動詞是「持續」，當副詞是「上次」。

bank.s: The meeting will ___ for two hours, so please have lunch first.
bank.e: last 當動詞：持續。The meeting will last for five hours.

bank.s: This shop sells soft ___ only. You can't buy beer here.
bank.e: drink 當名詞：飲料。soft drinks 不含酒精的飲料。

bank.s: The latest movie is ___ at Great Theater. Let's go see it tonight.
bank.e: show 當動詞可指「上映」。

bank.s: When did you ___ see your cousin?
bank.e: last 當副詞：上次。When did you last see him?

bank.s: I ___ at 6:30 a.m. during the weekdays, but I sleep late on weekends.
bank.e: wake up 醒來；stay up (late) 熬夜。

bank.s: Sam and Jake are good friends. They ___ with each other and enjoy spending time together.
bank.e: get along (with) 相處融洽。

bank.s:
Lily: Oh no! I forgot my hat.
Brian: You can ___ your jacket and use it to cover your head from the sun.
bank.e: take off 脫掉（也有「起飛」的意思）。put on 穿上。

bank.s:
Waiter: ___
Marcus: Sure. I'd like a hamburger with fries.
bank.e: Are you ready to order? 你準備好要點餐了嗎？回答 Sure 後接著點餐。

bank.s:
Waiter: ___
Customer: For here, please.
bank.e: For here or to go? 內用或外帶？

bank.s:
A: How would you like your steak?
B: ___
bank.e: How would you like your steak? 您的牛排要幾分熟？Medium 五分熟。

bank.s: The kids ___ late to watch the basketball game last night.
bank.e: stay up (late) 熬夜。

bank.s: Please ___. The baby is sleeping.
bank.e: keep quiet 保持安靜。

bank.s: We ___ in the big city. We didn't know where we were.
bank.e: get lost 迷路。

bank.s: Tom fell off his bike and ___. His mom took him to the doctor.
bank.e: get hurt 受傷。

bank.s: My aunt ___ last month. She wore a beautiful white dress.
bank.e: get married 結婚。get together 聚集、團聚。

bank.s: She finally ___ being scared of spiders.
bank.e: get over 恢復；克服。

bank.s: He helped me ___ a difficult time when I felt sad.
bank.e: get through 熬過；通過。

bank.s: I need a vacation to ___ from schoolwork.
bank.e: get away 逃走；遠離。

bank.s: These shoes are ___. They are only $500 now.
bank.e: be on sale 拍賣；打折。have a sale 舉行拍賣。

bank.s: Can I ___ this T-shirt? I want to see if it fits me.
bank.e: try on 試穿。

bank.s: I'm sorry, I don't have any ___ for the bus. Only a 1000-dollar bill.
bank.e: I don't have any change. 我沒有零錢。

bank.s: The T-shirt looks good ___ you.
bank.e: The T-shirt looks good on you.＝You look good in the T-shirt.

bank.s:
Oscar: I checked my report twice before I handed it in. There shouldn't be any mistake in it.
Lily: Well, I found ___.
bank.e: mistake 可數，found several（好幾個）。a little／much 修飾不可數名詞。

bank.s:
Andy: Why doesn't Lucy show up?
Tom: She called just now to say she's going to be ___ minutes late.
bank.e: minutes 可數，用 a few（一些）。a little 修飾不可數名詞。

bank.s: Can I have a ___ of paper? I need to take some notes in the meeting.
bank.e: a piece of paper 一張紙。

bank.s: We saw many stars in the sky last night. But we don't see ___ tonight.
bank.e: 否定句用 any（當代名詞＝any stars）。

bank.s: There ___ six cans of coffee in the box.
bank.e: 物質名詞加量詞後，單複數看量詞：six cans → are。

bank.s: Could I have ___ orange juice, please? I only need a small glass to start my day.
bank.e: orange juice 不可數，要用 a little。

bank.s: She bought ___ oranges at the store to make fresh juice.
bank.e: orange 可數，用 many；肯定句不用 any。

bank.s:
Wayne: ___ pencils do you have in your pencil case?
Jack: I have ten.
bank.e: pencils 可數 → How many。

bank.s:
Tyson: ___ water do I need to drink in a day?
Mr. Robinson: Well, drink when you feel thirsty.
bank.e: water 不可數 → How much water。若有量詞 glasses 才用 How many glasses of water。

bank.s:
Iris: ___ bottles of juice do we need?
Joe: Three bottles.
bank.e: 量詞 bottles 可數 → How many bottles of juice。

bank.s:
A: How much ___ these apples?
B: They are four for one hundred dollars.
bank.e: 問價格：How much is＋單數物品／How much are＋複數物品。

bank.s: We don't have ___ homework today, so we can go to the movies.
bank.e: homework 不可數，用 much（否定句常用）。

bank.s: I have ___ friends in Taiwan, so I often feel lonely.
bank.e: few 幾乎沒有（表否定），friends 可數。a few 是「有一些」，語意就不會孤單。

bank.s: He drank ___ milk, so he is still thirsty.
bank.e: little 幾乎沒有（表否定），milk 不可數。

bank.s: There is ___ bag of rice under the table.
bank.e: a／數字＋量詞＋of＋名詞：a bag of rice，動詞用單數 is。

bank.s: If you have ___ questions, you can ask me after class.
bank.e: if 條件句用 any。

bank.s: We are drinking coffee. Would you like ___?
bank.e: 疑問句表「邀請人吃東西」或期待肯定回答時用 some。

bank.s:
A: Did you eat any bread?
B: Yes, I ate ___.
bank.e: 肯定回答用 some（＝some bread）；否定回答 No, I didn't eat any.

bank.s: There are two ___ of beef in the fridge.
bank.e: 量詞前的數字是 2 以上時，量詞要變複數：two pounds of beef。
